macros.name: AllActive
macros.doc: \AllActive put the \catcode for all characters above 127 to \active.

macros.name: AllOther
macros.doc: \AllOther put the \catcode for all characters above 127 to the value 12 (other).

macros.name: codepage
macros.doc: After the call of \codepage all the characters above 127 are “active”.

macros.name: MakeHyphenationLetter
macros.doc: This macro allow a special letter to be use in a \hyphenation command to declare hyphenation exceptions.

macros.name: TRfalse
macros.doc: \TRfalse to suppress the translation of special character.

macros.name: TRtrue
macros.doc: \TRtrue to allow the translation of special characters (this is the default value !).
